scope: Single remote read-only audit of all 180 v39 clean traces and diagnostic records, including all successful controls. No model generation, tool execution, training, attacks or real endpoints.
known_before_audit: V39 syntax_retry had 17 failures despite parsed calls and 5 zero-call failures; aggregate outcomes are already known. This is exploratory diagnosis, never independent confirmation.
observations: terminal unparsed function marker after at least one tool result
terminal tool-intention wording after tool results using the unchanged historical heuristic

interpretation: Nonexclusive observable indicators, not mutually exclusive proven causes. Token cap hits are not proof of truncation; calls with no error are not proof of correct reasoning. Preserve other/unknown and inspect success counterexamples. Never read expert solutions or rerun evaluators to tune a repair.
integrity: 180 distinct row/raw/diagnostic mappings; original utility/status and parsed counts agree; archive intact. Outcomes are used for reporting groups only, never for an online repair trigger.
next_step: After this descriptive audit, select one locally observable mechanism and separately preregister new-seed end-to-end clean controls, including a matched extra-generation control. Maximum 240 screening plus 120 conditional confirmation episodes; no automatic attacks or world-model fitting. Stop the fixed cycle on integrity failure or scientific NO_GO without changing thresholds.
